title: Hotel price tracker
description: Two row types share one dataset: rate (one property and check-in date with the lowest rate across every booking source, the cheapest source and the date's rank in the window; charged) and status (one per property: how many dates were searched, delivered, filtered or failed; never charged).

dataset.title: Rate rows
dataset.description: Rate rows and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, the cheapest rate and date found, how many dates were filtered or failed, and the RPC stats.
